I have implemented fine-grained persisted query state restoration across `@tanstack/query-core`, `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`, and the framework adapters on branch `fix/persister-restore-state`:

### Summary of Changes

1. **Snapshot Restoration Marker & Core State Normalization** ([query.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts), [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/types.ts), [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/index.ts)):
   - Added and exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L170-L188) (along with [`PersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L161-L168), [`isPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L190-L200), [`resolveRestoredData`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L202-L242), and [`normalizeRestoredState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L244-L293)) from `@tanstack/query-core` and re-exported from `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core` and all framework adapters.
   - Updated [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L707-L729) to detect restored snapshot markers returned by `options.persister` and adopt the normalized snapshot state directly (`fetchStatus: 'idle'`, preserving error states, failure counts/reasons, timestamps, invalidation markers, and infinite query `pages`/`pageParams`) without invoking `setData` or normal `onSuccess`/`onSettled` cache callbacks.

2. **Observer Result Consistency** ([queryObserver.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts)):
   - Updated [`shouldFetchOnMount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L368-L395), [`shouldFetchOptionally`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L409-L426), and [`createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L539-L695) so restored queries preserve persisted `status`, `isRefetchError`, `failureCount`, `failureReason`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `isStale`, and `isFetchedAfterMount` across both single-query execution and bulk restoration.

3. **Fine-Grained Persister & Bulk Reconciliation** ([createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts)):
   - Updated [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L283-L359) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data, state })` when restoring from storage.
   - Updated [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L387-L456) and added [`reconcileRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L24-L90) to rebuild full query snapshots and independently merge data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) when reconciling with existing in-memory queries.

4. **Framework Adapter Fixes & Tests** ([solid-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/solid-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts), [vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts), [vue-query/src/useQueries.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j_uw5me8/packages/vue-query/src/useQueries.ts)):
   - Ensured Solid Query and Vue Query adapters properly subscribe and expose restored query data and metadata, and added tests across `query-core`, `query-persist-client-core`, `react-query`, `preact-query`, `solid-query`, `svelte-query`, `vue-query`, and `angular-query-experimental`.
